blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial government is proposing to cap live hog shipments from Negros Oriental at 1,500 heads per week, down from the more than 2,500 heads currently recorded entering the province weekly. But why is the provincial government seeking to limit incoming shipments, and how does this figure relate to Cebu’s local hog production and demand? Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro said the proposal sought to address competition faced by local backyard hog raisers while maintaining sufficient supply for consumers, particularly during peak seasons.
